criteria.evidence: Delta 4c415c21..93e08756 (one commit, 2 files, +39/-0). TailorNavKeys.kt line 42: navigateToTailoring returns when state.currentKey is a TailoringNavKey for the same applicationId, so a double tap, or a second tap from the outgoing screen during the transition, finds Tailoring(r1) on top (the stack add is synchronous) and adds no Tailoring(r2). Delta finding 1 (F1) is fixed. A re-tailor after a finished run still mints a new runId, because replace() puts Tailored on top and the guard does not fire. TailorFailedNavigation.retry still replaces with the same runId and does not go through this function. The debug target still mints a UUID per open. Delta finding 2 (F2: in prod the run-<runId> marker never exists, so a restored run sends a new requestId) is out of scope for #317. It is tracked as #322 under D58, to be built on the W4 branch that holds #314 + #317, and it is not counted as open here.

NavigateToTailoringTest.twoRapidCallsLeaveOneTailoringKey fails without the guard. Navigator.navigate (core/navigation Navigator.kt line 14) drops only a key equal to currentKey, and Tailoring(r1) != Tailoring(r2), so the stack would hold 2 TailoringNavKeys, not 1. tapAfterTheRunFinishedMintsANewRunId pins the other side: after replace(Tailored(app-1)), a second call adds a key whose runId differs from the first, so a guard that blocked a re-tailor would fail it. No existing test was changed. NavBackStack comes from core:navigation's api(navigation3.runtime), which TailorFailedNavigationTest and TailorEntryKeysTest already use. CI at 93e08756: Constitution policy, pregate and Detect code changes pass. Static checks, Core/Feature/App unit tests, Screenshot tests, Lint and Assemble APKs were pending when reviewed. I did not run Gradle locally because the worktree is read-only for this review.

Nothing else changed: git diff --stat 4c415c21 93e08756 lists only TailorNavKeys.kt (+1 line) and the new NavigateToTailoringTest.kt. Runner, spend, mapper, assembler and export code are byte-identical to the delta review, so the c6/c8/c11 verdicts from pr-317-delta.json stand.
